_about: My labels (manual, session sol_score) for the blind sample of policy_underspecified (eval/blind_policy_underspecified.json, drawn before the run from the cases folder alone). Each trial is labelled from its evidence only (kit/view.py: request, candidates, commands, responses, final answer, diff), before any judge verdict on it is read, with judge v2's outcome definitions. Sol's reasoning is not recorded, so a mechanism rests on the final answer and on what the responses showed.
